How much RAM the game may use. 4 to 6 GB suits most modpacks; more than it needs only slows garbage collection.

On servers without JEI, JEI says in chat that the server didn't send its recipes. It's harmless, so the launcher turns the message off. Takes effect the next time you press Play.
